globalNews.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
globalNews.summary: The storm cut power to more than 20,000 households and left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

globalNews.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
globalNews.summary: BBC's Top Comment podcast has found a network of Instagram profiles glamourising the swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence.

globalNews.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
globalNews.summary: A new US report said China had moved goods through nations with lower tariffs to dodge higher levies.

globalNews.title: Builders unearth €9m gold loot sealed in walls of Belgian property
globalNews.summary: Construction workers found the stash in the walls of a cellar while drilling to lay sewage pipes.

globalNews.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
globalNews.summary: A man is arrested after eight works by the French artist are found at a home in greater São Paulo.

cryptoNews.title: Binance to restrict transactions involving HTX, 10 other crypto platforms
cryptoNews.summary: Binance said it will stop processing transactions for involving 11 crypto platforms, including HTX, which was recently listed in the EU’s sanctions package targeting Russia.

cryptoNews.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
cryptoNews.summary: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.

cryptoNews.title: Gemini posts $108M Q2 net loss despite 37% revenue growth
cryptoNews.summary: Credit card and staking revenue drove Gemini’s services growth in Q2 as exchange revenue fell 38% and trading volume dropped by two-thirds.

cryptoNews.title: Shinhan Asset Management partners with Plume on tokenized fund pilot
cryptoNews.summary: Shinhan Asset Management and Plume will test a tokenized fund using a Korean won-denominated ultra-short-term bond fund as its underlying asset.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin eyes new August lows as Binance longs face ‘cleanout’
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin futures open interest on Binance fell alongside BTC price as analysis published on CryptoQuant flagged mounting pressure on leveraged longs.

aiNews.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
aiNews.summary: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

aiNews.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
aiNews.summary: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.

aiNews.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
aiNews.summary: AI is expensive, Ali Ghodsi tells TechCrunch. With so many investors wanting into his latest round, he said yes to more than planned.

aiNews.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
aiNews.summary: OpenAI is launching a preview of a sped up version of its latest, most powerful model, in an effort to court enterprise users.

aiNews.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
aiNews.summary: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies as part of this deal.
